name: Core
author: VidTSX
description: The built-in transitions and filters: the everyday ones, plus the craft packs the TSX builder can follow. More ship as importable packs — VidTSX Transitions — Volume 01 among them.

transitions.name: Push left
transitions.description: The next scene pushes the current scene off screen.

transitions.name: Wipe right
transitions.description: A crisp edge reveals the next scene from left to right.

transitions.name: Zoom through
transitions.description: Accelerate into the next scene with a soft scale dissolve.
transitions.usage: Travel, product details, and energetic cuts.

transitions.name: Iris open
transitions.description: A circular aperture opens from the center of the frame.
transitions.usage: Subject reveals and playful scene changes.

filters.name: Noir
filters.description: A punchy monochrome grade with soft cinematic edge shading.

filters.name: VHS Club
filters.description: Moving scan lines, tape interference, color ghosting, and a retro timestamp.

filters.name: Cinematic Bloom
filters.description: Soft light spills from bright lamps and reflections, with warm diffusion and clear, contrasting shadows.

craft.name: Infographic loop
craft.description: An animated infographic post: one whole picture on every frame, frame 0 is the poster, a seamless loop, and numbers made of countable marks.

craft.name: Concept to picture
craft.description: How to find the one picture that explains an idea: the mechanism, the numbers as countable things, actors doing the work.

craft.name: Blueprint
craft.description: A technical drawing come to life: blueprint blue, a fine grid, white outlines, an amber payoff, monospace type, precise motion.

craft.name: Flat bold
craft.description: Thick, friendly flat shapes on warm cream, saturated colours, round actors, bouncy motion.

craft.name: Neon dark
craft.description: A dark control room where the data glows: cyan lines, a magenta payoff, particles along paths.

craft.name: Editorial
craft.description: A newspaper's information graphic: newsprint, black rules, one red accent, a serif headline, restrained motion.

craft.name: Your own style
craft.description: Your own words for the look, turned into a full style (ground, ink, palette, type, details, motion) before the design.
